description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Drilling Engineering topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: drilling-engineering

source.quote: Hoists in the rig, a derrick, can lift hundreds of tons of pipe

source.quote: drill bits are usually mounted in a drill, which provides the rotational force needed to cut into the workpiece

source.quote: to exert hydrostatic pressure to prevent formation fluids from entering into the well bore, and carrying out drill cuttings

source.quote: stress can be applied but it will not flow until a certain value, the yield stress, is reached

facts.claim: Mud cools the bit and clears cuttings from beneath it

source.quote: The drilling fluid also keeps the drill bit cool and clears out cuttings beneath it during drilling

facts.claim: A blowout preventer seals the well to stop uncontrolled flow

source.quote: used to seal, control and monitor oil and gas wells to prevent blowouts

source.quote: Kicks can lead to a potentially catastrophic event known as a blowout
Directional drilling (or slant drilling) is the practice of drilling non-vertical bores

facts.claim: Casing pipe lines and supports the borehole, cemented in place

source.quote: The lower portion (and sometimes the entirety) is typically held in place with cement

facts.claim: Wells have several casing strings, each inside the previous

source.quote: a well contains multiple intervals of casing successively placed within the previous casing run

facts.claim: Oilwell (Portland) cements set by reaction with water

source.quote: Hydraulic cements such as Portland cement set and become adhesive through a chemical reaction between the dry ingredients and water
